The LOCK SCREEN as it was, FIVE things he sent himself and nothing else (his notifications are off), each its own press; beside it INTAKE's cards and nothing else (round two, 2026-10-21, Jon: 'what matters is showing the cards'): one hairline in the phone's silhouette on the paper, the cards inside, no app chrome; beneath both his CALENDAR, a real month, that pages to the day a landing takes.
